translations.web: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
translations.bsb: If anyone with earthly possessions sees his brother in need, but withholds his compassion from him, how can the love of God abide in him?
translations.kjv: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
translations.asv: But whoso hath the world's goods, and beholdeth his brother in need, and shutteth up his compassion from him, how doth the love of God abide in him?
